200 Returned if Tenable One successfully retrieved the list of asset properties.
400
Returned if your request specified an invalid asset class, if your request specified invalid parameters, or
if your request was improperly formatted.
401 Returned if the API keys specified in your request are invalid.
— 403 Returned if you do not have permission to view the list of asset properties.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
500 Returned if an internal error occurred in Tenable One.
